text.description_html:
Emtek C5059STU, Contemporary Stuttgart Leverset with Disc Rose

The Stuttgart Lever has a modern feel that is only made sleeker by the use of a concealed fastener mechanism that makes it so the rosette has no exposed screws. This is perfect for a clean look once installed. The Concealed fastener is only available on privacy and passage functions. Dummy functions are surface mounted. The Stuttgart Lever with Disc Rose is available in dummy, passage, or privacy functions for your interior or exterior doors. Choose from a wide array of modern finish colors. The Stuttgart Lever with Disc Rose CF will fit most standard pre doors cut-outs.

Features of the Stuttgart Door Leverset with Disc Rose:

  • Fits standard door cut outs (2-1/8" pre-drilled doors).
  • Lever is surface mounted (rosette screws to the door's face).
  • Solid brass lever and trim rose.
  • Sold as complete set.
  • Easy to install.

Specifications of the Emtek Stuttgart Lever with Disc Rose:

  • Material: Brass
  • Lever Length: 5-1/2"
  • Lever Projection: 2"
  • Clearance: 1-1/4"
  • Rose Diameter: 2-1/2"
  • Door Thickness: 1-1/4 - 3"
  • Backset: 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"

Available Functions:

  • Double Dummy: No door latch. Door levers on both sides of the door. Package Includes: 2 levers, 2 roses, and mounting screws.
  • Passage (Hall or Closet): For doors that don't need locking. Latch operates from either side of door. Package Includes: 2 levers, 2 roses, door latch, strike plate, dust box, faceplate, spindle, and mounting screws.
  • Privacy (Bedroom or Bathroom): For doors that could need privacy locking. Latch operates from either side. Push button on interior rose engages privacy; emergency release hole is on exterior rose. Turning inside lever will release privacy push button and retract the door latch. Package Includes: 2 levers, 2 roses, privacy button, door latch, strike plate, dust box, faceplate, spindle, and mounting screws.

Levers are Handed. Handing Guide
